melder.aether.spellbook.spell_compiler.c.label: site_plan_lowering
melder.aether.spellbook.spell_compiler.c.role: Shared lowering that turns a root's steps and one key set into a compiled construction plan.
responsibilities: hosts SitePlanStep, SitePlanRuntimeHelpers, SitePlanLowering and SitePlanEmission

melder.aether.spellbook.spell_compiler.c.label: SitePlanStep
melder.aether.spellbook.spell_compiler.c.role: Family-neutral view of one no-overrides construction step, read by the lowering and the generic construct helpers.
responsibilities: normalizes many_only and generalized step rows into one shape
returns a masked copy without the supplied parameters' dependency and contract operands
serves as a plan_step for the no-overrides generic helpers

melder.aether.spellbook.spell_compiler.c.label: SitePlanRuntimeHelpers
melder.aether.spellbook.spell_compiler.c.role: Cold-path helpers emitted plans call: generic construction with supplied values, the plans' refusals and the managed lease returns.
responsibilities: constructs a masked step with supplied values applied last
raises the P2 error for a supplied value on a stored shared instance
raises UnresolvedInputError before a site with unsupplied unresolved inputs is built
refuses equal-rank keys that supply different values (E1)
return_leases(error, leases): puts back every lease a plan took for a holder that was never built, each failing put-back added as a note on the propagating error (0.2.8245)
return_unused_leases(leases): puts back the leases of a shared holder whose cold race another meld won, every pair attempted, failures raised as one ExceptionGroup (0.2.8245)

raise_missing_managed_pool(spell): the named MeldExecutionError of a managed site whose pool cannot be read - its owner root torn down, or its owner store holding no pool for the version (0.2.8245); since 0.2.8248 conjure stamps the versions staged before it, so the message no longer names that cause or the 'stage the version after conjure' remedy

melder.aether.spellbook.spell_compiler.c.label: SitePlanLowering
melder.aether.spellbook.spell_compiler.c.role: Builds the site graph from steps, computes a key set's demand and emits one plan's source.
responsibilities: builds the site graph from steps and live topologies through the processor strategy's builder
walks demand from the root, skipping parameters with a winning key
emits the normal (meld) plan for the empty key set and (meld, ov) plans otherwise
decides where operands may go positionally (positional_run)
passes a door route key to normal-mode emission only and refuses one for key-set plans
lowers a managed_spell_quantity step as a per-path site leased from its pool, leasing or fresh (see SitePlanEmission); the warm lease takes no lock and the miss only the pool's leaf lock (0.2.8245)

melder.aether.spellbook.spell_compiler.c.label: SitePlanEmission
melder.aether.spellbook.spell_compiler.c.role: Per-plan emission state: places steps at top level or inside shared-site misses and renders the plan source.
responsibilities: places many sites with their consumer and shared sites at their consumers' common context
emits hit reads with out-of-line misses that build children before taking the build guard
chooses a direct call or generic construction per step and builds call arguments
emits conflict guards and unresolved-input refusals at context tops
leaves out the root miss's guard in a normal plan whose calling route door already holds it (unique_per_conduit and spellspace roots, 0.2.73)

emits a dict literal of exactly the dependency values a generic construction reads, where it runs (lazy instance_results, 2026-10-03): no dict at the plan top, no per-step stores, no dict parameter on misses; _place passes a generic member's providers into its miss like a direct member's operands

binds an automatic world's unique-site owner store as a plan constant (owner-store constants, 2026-10-03): _owner_store_constant admits a unique site whose provider spell is owned by an automatic conduit and has an owner store; _emit_shared_hit then binds c{i} in the namespace and emits no alias line, while dynamic, unowned and meld.<store> sites keep the per-creation read and the miss keeps its c{i} parameter

registers every disposal-bearing many site through many_store, the meld's innermost scope (the spellspace store, else the conduit store), at the top level and inside a shared site's miss alike (0.2.8267): a function that registers one emits the store selection (_many_store_prologue) - the plan at its top, a miss after its unresolved-input check - so a slotted holder's many children belong to the scope that built them, never to the holder's owner (0.2.8235-0.2.8265 registered them in the holder's store and, from 0.2.8238, recorded them with the holder); warm _site_plan_executor bodies are unchanged

emits managed sites (0.2.8245): a leasing site (no winning key on its own parameters) has its own miss and exactly one consumer, and its lease - an inline pop of a plan-constant pool on an automatic owner, else a per-creation pool read whose miss raises the named missing-pool error - is emitted in its consumer's lease group; the miss checks unresolved inputs, reserves, builds the children and the object inside a try whose handler abandons, then adopts the disposal-bearing many children; a fresh site (a winning key on its own parameters) is built like a many step and never pooled

puts every lease of a consumer back when its construction region raises (_return_leases) and returns a lost cold race's unused leases (_return_unused_leases); a plan without a managed step is byte-identical and binds none of the three helpers (0.2.8245)

binds each slotted and many site's sid{i} to its Spell's store key (<spell_id>:<binding_hash>) and publishes a no-disposal slotted miss through c{i}.register_slot(sid{i}, v{i}), so a plan reads, guards and files only its own binding's slot; a leasing managed site's sid{i} stays the spell id for its pool read (0.2.8274)

edges_authored.why: build_site_graph turns steps into temporary injection specs and calls the processor's builder, so fresh and cache-hit plans read one structure.
emit creates one emission per plan and cleans it after render; the namespace and masked steps go to the caller.
Binds the helpers into every plan namespace for generic construction and the plans' refusals.
Reads sites, parameter rows and socket kinds for placement, operands and unresolved-input checks.
The lease returns put leased objects back through the pool's put_back.
An automatic owner's leasing site binds the pool and its _idle.pop as plan constants.
